patches.reason: The forfeit URL was checked by opening a network connection to it (new URL(link).openConnection().connect() in a try/catch), which a package cannot do, so a non-blank URL was never accepted and the script asked for it forever. As in guillotine (owner decision 2026-10-10): a URL that starts with http counts as valid; any other non-blank answer is refused as before, and a blank one goes on as before.

Legacy bug (creator report): the start sets defaults for keys that are missing, and the one for stripordie.no_estim saves stripordie.audio_estim = false instead. no_estim is never saved, so every start reset the audio e-stim choice to false and the game used the external-device branch, although the setup text calls audio e-stim the default. Save no_estim = false, as the test intends.
